passages.statement: Kettlehold is the last town before the summit of the Ashbell Pass.
The Kettle & Coal stands on the edge of Saltgate market.
The Old Mine has been sealed since the Night of Ash.
Locals call Kettlehold's high road the Kettle's Spout.
Whoever rings the Ashbell loses their voice until the next sunrise.
Aldous Ashdown died ringing the Ashbell on the Night of Ash.
The Night of Ash buried the lower town of Kettlehold.
The Ember Well grants Ashsight only to those who drink from it before dawn.
Ashsight lets its bearer see the heat left by footsteps for about a day.
Only the Order of the Quiet Flame may draw water from the Ember Well.
Hesper Quill leads the Order of the Quiet Flame.
Captain Rourke Dale commands the Pass Guard.
The Red Mule Caravan carries salt and lamp oil up the pass twice a year.
Walking from the Bell Gate to Saltgate takes forty-five minutes.
Climbing from the Cinder Bridge to Stillfire Abbey takes twenty minutes.
The Red Mule Caravan camps at the Foot of the Pass on Day 0.
The Cinder Bridge spans the steam gorge between Kiln Street and the Abbey stair.
The Bronze Clapper weighs as much as a grown goat.
The Cinder Key is a warm iron key that never cools.
The Cinder Key opens any door sealed by the Order of the Quiet Flame.
Ashsight fades if its bearer sleeps before following the trail.
Ves Calloway is a caravan scout for the Red Mule Caravan.
Corin Ashdown is the Bellwarden of Kettlehold.
Ysolde Marr is the captain of the Red Mule Caravan.
Ysolde and Corin were sworn partners until Ysolde broke the oath at 18:00 on Day 2.
Captain Rourke Dale has served in the Pass Guard for nineteen winters.
Abbess Hesper Quill has not left Stillfire Abbey since the Night of Ash.
Aldous Ashdown was Corin's father.
Mother Brisk is the innkeeper of the Kettle & Coal.
Mother Brisk is at the Kettle & Coal at 18:00 on Day 3.
Mother Brisk is at Saltgate at 07:30 on Day 4.
Odo Fenn is the lamplighter of Kettlehold.
Tamsin Wick is a courier between Kettlehold and Stillfire Abbey.

Ysolde asks Corin to leave the Cinder Bridge open after dusk.
The Ashbell makes no sound at dusk on Day 2.
